(na)༄༅/ /lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid kyi dkar chag bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi rgyun/ /rdo rje'i tshig don

tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid kyi dkar chag bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi rgyun// rdo rje'i tshig don gangs can 'dir// bcu drug cha yi zla ba ltar// gang gi mdzad pa de la 'dud// zab mo'i don 'di snyigs dus su// rang dga'i dri mas mi gos shing*// kun nas nub par mi 'gyur bar// bya phyir dkar chag tho 'di bri// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la gang zag gi blo rigs kyis slob ma bkri ba'i tshul mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod do// de yang gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i steng na khrid tshul brgyad de/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba dang*/ snang ba gsum du bkri ba dang*/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyis bkri ba dang*/ lam thabs rgyud kyi bkri ba dang*/ lam bzhi re res bkri ba'o// gnad drug gis bkri ba la lnga ste/ rim pa ji bzhin bkri ba dang*/ lam bzhi re res bkri ba'o// dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis bkri ba la drug ste/ thabs kyi la gsum/ shes rab kyi la gsum mo// gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba dang*/ lam zab bla ma dang*/ lam 'bring po dang*/ lam bsdus pa dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med dang*/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod dang*/ lam sbas bshad de/ de rnams la re re dang*/ brda don gsal ba'i steng na gsum ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad do// //de rnams la thun gyi nges pa yang bri bar bya ste/ thams cad kyi sngon 'gro chos bcu gnyis la thun gsum ste/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bsag sbyang gnyis la thun gcig sbyang ba gsum la thun gcig de gnyis khrid kyi sngon 'gro'o// thun re re'i sngon du 'gro ba/ gnad la dbab pa gsum dang*/ bsgom pa gsum la thun gcig go /gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i brgyad la/ snang ba gsum la nyi shu rtsa bdun/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la lnga bcu rtsa gcig lam thabs rgyud la bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi ste/ brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// de la snang ba gsum gyi nyi shu rtsa bdun ni/

ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la thun re re/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la spyi dang bye brag la re re/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa la gcig de phan 'dogs che ba la gcig de yun ring du mi gnas pa la gnyis te/ nges par 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la gzhan cis kyang mi phan pa gsum la re re/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi las 'bras bsam pa la re re/ byams pa bsgoms pa la gsum/ snying rje la gsum/ smon pa la gcig 'jug pa la gsum/ don dam la gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams snang la gcig dag pa'i snang ba la gcig ste nyi shu rtsa bdun no// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi lnga bcu rtsa gcig ni/ mdor bstan pa gcig de nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis bsgoms pa la gcig sems dang*/ sgyu ma dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ brjod bral bzhi la brgyad brgyad/ btus pa'i dpe bzhi la re re/ gtso bo gcig tu bsdus pa'i gcig tshang brtsi ba la gcig dkyil 'khor/ dbang*/ de'i ye shes gsum la re re/ dbang bzhi'i lam so so la re re/ ma dag pa'i/ lam/ 'bras bu'i nyams snang gsum la re re/ gnas gyur lhun grub mi 'gal ba la gcig ste lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /lam thabs rgyud kyi bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi ni/ bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang*/ de la sems gzung ba gnyis la re re/ sbyang ba gsum la gcig rlung sbyor bdun po re re/ gtum mo'i bco brgyad la re re/ gsum pa'i lam la brgyad/ bzhi pa'i lam la brgyad de/ bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'o// gnad drug gis bkri ba'i lnga la/ rim pa ji bzhin bkri ba la drug cu rtsa dgu/ re rer bkri ba la/ bum dbang la bcu gnyis/ gsang dbang la sum cu/ shes rab ye shes la nyi shu/ bzhi pa la nyer gcig go /dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi bkri ba'i drug la/ thabs phyogs kyi tha ma la/ lha bsgom pa dang*/ lta ba'i rgyas gdab pa gnyis/ 'bring la lha bskyed/ dbang blang*/

rgyas gdab pa ste gsum mo// rab la lha bsgom/ lta ba bskyang*/ las tshogs bsgrub pa ste gsum mo// shes rab kyi tha ma la/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ste gsum/ 'bring la lha bsgom pa dang*/ dbang blang ba dang*/ sems gzung tshul lnga ste bdun no// rab ni tha ma'i gsum sngon du song nas/ gnad drug la thun bzhi bcu zhe lnga'o// gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba ni gnad drug la thun bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ lam zab la bsgom zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ zhen pa spang ba dang*/ dbang blang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid la blo gzhag pa ste thun bzhi'o// lam 'bring po la rlung gis lam khrid pa la bdun/ bdud rtsis lam khrid pa la gsum/ yi ges khrid pa la bcu gnyis te nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// lam bsdus pa la gcig go /'khor 'das dbyer med la sngar gyi lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /dbang bzhi ngo sprod la sdom pa gsum la re re ste gsum/ lam sbas bshad la lnga ste/ sbyang ba gsum la gcig rlung srog rtsol la gcig phyi'i he ru ka gsal gdab pa/ nang thugs rdo rje gsal gdab cing brda don nges par bya ba/ bsgom pa dngos dang lnga'o// de ltar thams cad kyi thun re re'i mjug tu/ dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ de ma rtogs kyi sems can la snying rje bsgom/ rang nyid dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ rang gis kyang nam tur dran pa na nyams kyi rgyun goms par bya'o// thun gyi nges pa'o// //gsung sgros kyi nges pa yang bri bar bya ste/ khrid tshul nyi shu rtsa dgu las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med gnyis 'dra bas/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad do// lam zab bla ma dang*/ lam bsdus pa gnyis ni/ khrid tshar nas bsgom pa yin la/ gnad drug gis bkri ba dang*/ lam sbas bshad gnyis ni don khrid kho na yin/ gzhan lhag ma rnams ni/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi bkri ste lam 'bras kyis bkri bar mi nus pa'i gang zag mi srid pa'i tshod tsam yin no// gsung ngo*// de la dang po sngon 'gro byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i skabs su/

sems can thams cad la ma yin par shes pas byams pa ngang gis skye/ des snying rje ngang gis skye/ des smon pa ngang gis skye/ des 'jug pa ngang gis skye/ de don dam sems bskyed kyi ngang du gzhug gsung*/ don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la khrid tshul nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi kun gzhi rgyu rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi phyogs kyi dang mtha' gnyis ma gtogs pa thams cad la shes rab lta bas thag gcad pa'i dmigs pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs re mgo bor gzugs so// gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i las 'bras bsam pa'i skabs su/ mdzod las/ sdug bsngal ba dang gsad phyir dang*// gzi byin nyams phyir 'bras rnams gsum// zhes pas/ re re la rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang*/ rgyu mthun gyi dang*/ dbang 'bras te gsum gsum du bshad do// don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i skabs su/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med par mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes pa'i don bshad do// yang lam la 'khor 'das dbyer med brtsi ba la/ dbang bzhi'i lam la brtsi ba dang*/ rim gnyis la brtsi ba gnyis gang mos bya'o// de rnams ngag don dril zhing bkri'o// gnad drug gis bkri ba'i lnga la rim pa bzhin bkri ba tshig khrid du yang mdzad/ rkang thon du bkri ba ni don khrid yin pas/ de la bum dbang gi gnad drug ni/ rgyu la gnas pa la/ rten rtsa gsum/ pho brang drug pulli ra mā la ya la sogs pas so// brten pa kun gzhi gnyug ma'o// brten tshul me tog dang dri'i tshul du gnas so// de la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom mo// de nas dbang las thob pa ni/ bla ma las bum dbang blangs te de'i dus su ngo 'phrod par bya'o// de nas lam la goms pa ni/ bum dbang gi lam brda don gsal ba bzhin bsgom ste ngo bo nyid gsum zung du nyams skyes skyes bsgom/

de nas lta ba la nyams su myong ba ni/ sngar gyi nyams myong brten par byed pa ste/ don rang bzhin lhan skyes so// de nas grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba ni/ phyi nang de kho na nyid gsum gyi rtags kyis mtshon pa'i/ rtags can lam bsgom pa'o// de nas 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa ni/ sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub ste/ de yang gzhi kun gzhi lhun grub/ lta bas bsdus pa'i sku bzhi lhun grub/ grub mthas bsdus pa'i sku bzhi lhun grub/ mthar phyin 'bras bus bsdus pa'i sku bzhi lhun grub ste bzhir 'gyur te/ drug kar ci rigs su shes shing goms par bya'o// des na bum dbang gcig pus lam mthar phyin pa ste/ gzhan gsum ngang gis 'byung ste/ lha gsal stong gsang dbang gi lam/ bde stong gsum pa'i lam/ snang gsal bde gsum gang yang zung du chud pa bzhi pa'i lam mo// de bzhin du gzhan gsum yang rkang thon du bkri ste don gyis shes pas ma sbyar ro// sku bzhi ni/ snang stong*/ gsal stong*/ bde stong*/ thams cad rang stong du shes pa bzhi/ go rim bzhin du sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku bzhir 'jog pas/ de rim pa bzhin du/ rang bzhin lhan skyes/ rang rig lhan skyes/ zhu bde lhan skyes/ rnam kun mchog ldan lhan skyes te bzhir 'gro la/ 'di rnams shes pas tshig gi mdud pa don gyis grol ba yin no// gags sel dang*/ bogs 'don dang*/ sa mtshams dang*/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad de 'dir dgos ma nges pas/ de dag gang dgos su sleb par bya'o// yang dbang bzhi ngo sprod ni/ sdom pa gsum ldan gcig khrid tshul nyi shu rtsa brgyad gang gis bskyangs kyang de'i khrid tshar nas/ de nas dbang bzhi ngo sprod de/ sdom pa gsum dbang bzhi'i ye shes su ro gcig par rtogs pa'i gnad do// de la nyon mongs pa dug gsum gang rung gcig tol skyes pa na/ de gnyen pos spong*/

dge ba'i sbyin pa lta bu gang rung gcig gis mi mthun phyogs gnyen pos spong zhing dad 'dun dngos por dmigs pas bsgrub pa de so so thar pa'i sdom pa yin te/ des kyang spang bya spong*/ gnyen pos bsgrubs kyang kun mkhyen mi thob ste/ 'khor gsum du zhen pas so// de dbang bzhi'i lam du ngo sprod pa ni/ spang gnyen gdod nas dag pa yin pas der ngo shes dgos te/ de snang bzhin du stong pa bum dbang gi lam/ don rang bzhin lhan skyes/ gsal bzhin du stong pa gsang dbang gi lam/ don rang rig lhan skyes/ snang rung gsal rung rang rang gis stong pas dngos 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal med pas bde/ bde bzhin du stong pa gsum pa'i lam/ don zhu bde lhan skyes/ de ltar rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa de yang 'phral du byas pa ma yin gyis gdod nas dag par 'dug pa de bzhi pa'i lam/ de don rnam kun mchog ldan no// de ltar shes pas rnam rtog chos nyid kyi dbang du 'dus/ chos nyid rnam rtog gi dbang du mi 'gro bas/ 'khor 'das kyi legs tshogs thams cad nang nas 'grig cing rang gzhan dbang du mi 'gro ba'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no// de dbang bzhi'i lam du ngo sprod pa man chad byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la yang sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa nyon mongs pa dug gsum gang rung gcig tol skyes pa'am dge ba phar phyin drug lta bu de byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs nas lam du bsgyur ba byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yin la/ de dbang bzhi'i lam du ngo sprad pa ni sngar bzhin no// de la gnyis las bdag gzhan mnyam par bsgom pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ ser sna nas shes 'chal gyi bar la yang de bzhin no// bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig

bdag gi ma chags pa la sogs pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can gyis thob nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi ser sna nas 'chal tshul gyi bar thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig bdag gi sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyis thob nas sangs rgyas par rgyur cig snyam du bsgom pa'o// gsum pa snod bcud la brten pa'i nyon mongs rnam rtog gang skyes kyang*/ lha dang gzhal yas khang du shes pa bskyed rim/ ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes su shes pa rdzogs rim ste/ de dran 'dzin gyis sdom pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin la/ de snga ma bzhin dbang bzhi'i lam gyis ngo sprad pas 'bras bu sku bzhi lam du byed pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam du 'gyur ba yin pas bla mas zhib par ngo sprod do// //lam sbas bshad ni/ thog mar sbyang ba gsum zla ba drug sbyang*/ de nas rlung sbyor bdun mthar phyin gyi tshad byung byung sbyang*/ de nas 'gros bzhin bsgom ste/ phyi nang gi he ru ka gsal gdab pa bum dbang gi lam/ nang gi he ru ka yig 'brur gsal gdab pa dang*/ rlung kha sbyor bsgom pa gsang dbang gi lam/ des bde ba skyes pa gsum pa'i lam/ des las kyi rlung log nas ye shes kyi rlung du gyur pa bzhi pa'i lam/ lam bzhi cig car du bsgom mo// de las ye shes kyang cig car skye ste ldog pas phye ba'o// lam bsdus te bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ khrid tshar nas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor stan thog gcig tu dbang bzhi'i lam mnyam rjes thun bzhir bsgom pa yin te/ dam tshig pa yan chad phyi dbyibs kyi skyed chog rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang mos la/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i dus su lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas bsgom pa bum dbang gi lam/ de nas a thung gi mes lha rnams gsal bar blta zhing rlung srog rtsol gyi gnad kyis bsgom ste/

rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstun te pho brang drug mas rim gyis gsal gdab/ nang du 'jug pa dang bstun te yas rim gyis gsal gdab/ phyir gnas pa na/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor phug ron gyi sgo nga ngos gcig rdol ba lta bu 'am bum sku cung zad kha zhal phye ba lta bu'i dbus na rdo rje 'chang dang mi gnyis pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas rdor dril 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ yum gri gug thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'o// 'dab ma bzhi la phra gzugs ma'i lha mo bzhi gsal gdab nang du gnas pa na pho brang lnga pa'i mthar/ phyi dbyibs kyi a gsal gdab ste gsang dbang gi lam/ de nas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gcig las dbang bzhi blangs te/ yas 'bab dga' ba bzhi dbang gsum pa'i lam ste/ phyi dbyibs kyi a thig le'i dbus su bsgom mo// mas brtan dga' ba bzhis dbang rtags kyi rgyas gdab pa bzhi pa'i lam ste/ rigs lnga la rdo rje 'chang gi rgyas gdab/ sngar gyi gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo la sems bzung pas de las lhan skyes chen po'i ye shes skye ste/ der ro gcig ces bya'o// lam zab bla ma yang de don gyis shes par bya'o// de ltar na gzhi dang dbang dang lam dang lta ba dang grub mtha' dang 'bras bu ste drug ka yang*/ bcas zhes pa'i sgras mdud pa thams cad cig car grol ba yin no// de ltar khrid tshul nges pa can nyi shu rtsa brgyad dam rtsa dgus ni gang zag thams cad lam 'dis bkrir rung la/ thun tshad nges pas ni rang dgas bslad par mi nus/ gsung sgros nges pas ni snying po'i don gcig tu go ba'i dgos pa yod do// 'di la mchan med pa yin no// //gzhan yang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ zab mo'i lam 'di bcos pa dang*/ bslad pa dang*/ nub pa'i skyon gsum gyis 'jigs pa dang*/ 'di'i lam la mos pa dag ched cher gsol ba 'debs pa'i ngor/ tshig don las mi 'da' tsam gyi bar 'di/

chos 'di'i rigs su skyes pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gong ma'i tshogs la/ sems can thams cad snying phugs su bcug nas gsol ba btab cing*/ gnang ba thob nas sa bon tsam bris pa'o// 'di bla ma'i gsung med par yi ge tsam la brten nas bshad na dug dang bcas pa'i zas bzhin no// //thos dka' rnyed par dka' ba'i chos// zab cing shin tu zab pa'i don// mkhas pas legs bskyangs mkhas pas myong*// legs gsungs legs pa'i lam 'di sgoms// kho bo'i bla ma kho bo dang*// bcas pas 'di bshad 'di don bsgoms// de las gzhan smra logs pa yi// log pa yin gyis rjes ma 'brang*// lam 'bras snying po khrid yin pas// khrid tshul thun gsung nges pa can// dpang 'di dpang po'i dpang yin pas// dpal mgon srung ma rnams la gtad// 'chol pa med par rjes su skyongs// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid kyi dkar chag sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //sa māpta mi thi/ gu hya ga hya// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
